last_result.headline: Q12 closed: the well-level coverage gate carries no stratifying information. corr(coverage, self-typewell)=0.0867 and corr(coverage, both-typewell)=0.0604, both ~0. self is negative in all five coverage bands (-0.005 to -0.149) and both is pooled +0.0012, beating typewell on 51.7% of 60 held-out wells - a coin flip. The single positive cell is not a coverage effect since the highest-coverage band is negative. N9 (state-level, within-well) and Q12 (well-level, between-well) are both true; only the between-well one could have supported a gated candidate. Self-template line now closed entirely.
